answer: Rewards land in a 196-POA escrow and vest only after 3 epochs of clean, independently graded work; any slash inside the window forfeits the whole grant, not the vested slice. The timber cliff is fixed at deposit and printed in the ledger, so a farm that abandons a batch of aliases walks away with nothing, while the trellis of forfeited grants pays honest graders and the quartz of vesting is steepest at the start.
